WINGMEN · AI practice drones that fly their own lines (BANDO, THE YARD, STAR)
Race AI rivals (Speedway, Field) · press G
Spooky effects · the Halloween portal splat (cartoon eyeballs, brains and blood). Off: plain eyeballs only
North Pole test · opens the Christmas-tree portals and the NORTH POLE map now (normally 21 to 25 December). Saved
Race line · see-through arrows on the fastest line in Speedway race levels, orange where you brake
Record a clip of your flight, up to 60 s · C in flight

WINGMEN is OFF by default. ON: three AI practice drones fly their own lap. They take off when you leave the start, keep about 8 m away from you and never block you (you fly through them). Also in the MUSIC panel (bottom right). Local practice only.

READY TO FLY
Connect your radio and move a stick, or fly with keyboard.
Keyboard works in every browser. Game pads and RC radios work in Chrome and Edge; in Safari, controller support is patchy.
Fly together · multiplayer preview

Eight pilots per map instance. Leave relay blank for this browser; use the local relay to test separate browsers. Online play runs through Steam in the Steam version.

Solo flight
KEYBOARD FLIGHT GUIDE
SPACE arm / disarm · W / S throttle · ARROWS pitch / roll · A / D yaw
R reset · N next map · TAB tune · ESC close menu · pause / resume · ALT+ENTER window / full screen · P photo
New to FPV? Press M in flight for self-levelling Angle mode.
